title: The Wet Boots on the Rug You Denied
youtube_title: The Wet Boots on the Rug You Denied | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Pema is tangled up with a wet boots and a rug you almost blamed on the cat and almost hides it. Pema tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
